retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 80s pop aesthetic featuring a central subject against a pink airbrushed gradient with layered, high-contrast typography.
triggerTerms: layered inline serif and script text

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure in 80s athletic-casual wear crouching in a studio setting, framed by a hot pink to light pink gradient background, with large vertical serif lettering and a thin white script signature layered over the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically and horizontally in a crouching pose
Large display type positioned in the upper third behind the script
Thin script text crossing through the center of the display type
High-key lighting on subject contrasting with saturated pink background
coreInvariants: Layered typographic hierarchy with a script 'signature' over a bold serif
80s fashion elements including white tank top, denim, and slouch socks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central crouching figure occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large display typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large display text at the top, down through the script, to the subject's face, and finally to the white shoes at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample pink space on the left and right sides of the subject to emphasize the studio portrait feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Hot pink to light pink gradient (background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value (brightness) on the subject and text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast condensed serif and monoline script
letterConstructionRules: Display type uses extreme vertical compression with internal white inline stripes
Script type uses a consistent thin stroke weight mimicking a marker or pen
Script features long horizontal flourishes that extend beyond the word boundaries
characterSpecificRedesigns: Serif letters feature double vertical inline gaps
Script 'y' or end characters extend into vertical zig-zag flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast layering of a rigid, geometric serif with a fluid, organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and verticality of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman in 80s fashion (white tank top, denim shorts, white slouch socks) crouching centrally against a vibrant hot pink airbrushed gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large black condensed serif text with white inline stripes at the top. Layer a thin white monoline script signature over the center of the serif text, including a vertical zig-zag flourish on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth pink gradient?
Is the display text condensed with inline details?
Does the script text overlap the display text?
Is the subject in a centered crouching pose?

postGenerationChecks: Check for double-inline stripes in the serif font.
Ensure the script is legible but looks handwritten.
Verify the pink gradient is smooth without banding.
Confirm the subject's pose is a stable crouch.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Pop Portrait = (Crouching Subject + Pink Airbrushed Gradient) + (Condensed Inline Serif / Monoline Script Overlay)
